facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy, with the Communications Authority, issued a public notice on 26 August 2025 inviting stakeholders and the public to submit views on the Regulatory Impact Assessment of the draft Kenya Information and Communications Regulations.

The Ministry's notice of 26 August 2026 invited all stakeholders and the public to a virtual validation forum on 15 to 17 September 2026 on fifteen revised draft Kenya Information and Communications Regulations, with registration open to participants.

The Ministry said the submissions received on the 2025 notice were considered in revising the draft Kenya Information and Communications Regulations, and published a matrix of comments on the regulations' Regulatory Impact Statement alongside the revised drafts.

The Ministry said the stakeholder engagement and public participation on the draft Kenya Information and Communications Regulations were in line with Article 10 of the Constitution and sections 5 and 8 of the Statutory Instruments Act, Cap 2A, and that the Regulatory Impact Assessment was done in compliance with that Act.
